ambiguity: Migration cannot generate the permitted Integration-branch plan edit until it has an explicit branch selection.

selection_rule: If all credible legacy and plan evidence names one identical safe existing local branch, select it automatically; this is preservation of an observed value.

If the value is absent, conflicting, invalid or names no existing local branch, emit a stable `integration-branch` ambiguity. Never infer the branch from HEAD, `main`, a remote default, branch count or naming convention.

The ambiguity records every raw declaration and its source identity, plus the bounded set of safe existing local branch refs after excluding identified story branches. A resolution is `{ambiguity_id,kind:'integration-branch',observed,observed_identity,choice:{branch},rationale}`. The chosen branch must exactly equal an allowed observed local ref. No branch creation or arbitrary new name is part of migration.
If no eligible local branch exists, return BLOCKED with `INTEGRATION_BRANCH_UNAVAILABLE`; branch establishment requires a separate explicit action before rerunning preview.
dependent_plan_preview: When branch selection is required, the first mapped preview may remain BLOCKED while it emits the exact branch-dependent `plan-edit` ambiguity.

Using the selected branch, the engine generates only the allowed Integration-branch addition and optional legacy Instruction-rules removal, then reports the exact before blob, after blob and edit identity.

A final mapping must retain the integration-branch resolution and add the existing `{after_blob,edit_identity,accepted:true}` plan-edit resolution. READY requires both resolutions to match the same inventory identity and recomputed plan bytes.
Only the final complete mapping contributes mapping_hash and preview_id. The selection-only preview is read-only and cannot be applied or journaled.
validation: A consistent observed Integration branch cannot be overridden.
A stale inventory, changed branch-ref set, changed plan before blob, different selected branch, or recomputed after-blob mismatch returns DRIFT/BLOCKED before any write.
The selected branch and all conflicting or invalid original declarations remain in retained migration evidence.

scope: This pins selection and preview ordering only. It adds no policy, counter, authorization, branch mutation or arbitrary plan-replacement capability.
